cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Edith G. Halpert, New York, NY, by 1965; Estate of Edith G. Halpert, 1970; Sotheby Parke Bernet, Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 3520, lot no. 148, 16 May 1973; Coe Kerr Gallery, Inc., New York, NY, 1973; Douglas Drake Gallery, Kansas City, Missouri, 1974; Steven Straw Company, Newburyport, Massachusetts, 1976; James Maroney, Inc., New York, NY, 1977; (Grete Meilman Fine Art, Ltd., New York, NY), 1978; Private collection, New York, NY, 1978; (Grete Meilman Fine Art, Ltd., New York, NY); (Zaplin-Lampert Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico); Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1986 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "See gallery photo, 11–a. In second exhibition at "291" . . . Exam. at Whitney Mus, May 1946. . . . Note: Prob. ptd. 1915 or 1916." Not in second exhibition at 291. Whitney Archive dates 1915; Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1917; Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1918. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates: "O'Keeffe dated it 1918 in 1955 according to Betty Pilkington." Dated 1918 on basis of similarities to cat. nos. 253–255; completed in New York. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 22. Similar to work O'Keeffe is pictured painting in 1918 at Lake George, see Appendix III, figure 80. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Cerise and Green

description: A delicate red and blue circular form spirals out from the center of the composition. The shape resembles a woman's head with tendrils of long hair spreading out from it. Large swathes of plain paper are visible surrounding the forms.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Cerise and Green
